mapper.insert: insert ignore into corgi_user_follow (`user_id`, `follow_user_id`, `uptime`) values (#{userId}, #{followId}, NOW());
mapper.delete: delete from corgi_user_follow where user_id = #{userId} and follow_user_id = #{followId}
mapper.select: select follow_user_id from corgi_user_follow where user_id = #{userId} and is_deleted = '0'
select count(1) from corgi_user_follow where user_id = #{userId} and is_deleted = '0'

select count(1) from corgi_user_follow f1 join corgi_user_follow f2 on f2.follow_user_id = f1.user_id and f2.user_id = f1.follow_user_id where f1.user_id = #{userId} and f1.is_deleted = '0' and f2.is_deleted = '0'
select count(1) from corgi_user_follow where follow_user_id = #{userId} and is_deleted = '0'
select count(1) from corgi_user_follow where follow_user_id = #{userId}

select p.user_id userId, p.lat lat, p.lng lng, p.uptime `time`, d.nickname `nickname`, d.avatar avatar, d.role role, d.group `group`, d.con con, f.uptime followTime, l.im_id imId from corgi_user_follow f left join corgi_user_position p on f.follow_user_id = p.user_id left join corgi_user_detail d on d.user_id = p.user_id left join corgi_user_login l on l.id = p.user_id where f.user_id = #{userId} and is_deleted = '0'
order by f.id desc
order by p.uptime desc
order by if(p.lat < 200 and p.lng < 200,st_distance_sphere(point(#{lng},#{lat}),p.pt)/100000,100000)
limit #{start},#{size}

select p.user_id userId, p.lat lat, p.lng lng, p.uptime `time`, d.nickname `nickname`, d.avatar avatar, d.role role, d.group `group`, if(f.uptime > f1.uptime,f.uptime,f1.uptime) followTime, d.con con, l.im_id imId from corgi_user_follow f left join corgi_user_position p on f.follow_user_id = p.user_id left join corgi_user_detail d on d.user_id = p.user_id left join corgi_user_login l on l.id = p.user_id join corgi_user_follow f1 on f1.follow_user_id = f.user_id and f1.user_id = f.follow_user_id where f.user_id = #{userId} and f.is_deleted = '0' and f1.is_deleted = '0'
order by f.id desc
order by p.uptime desc
order by if(p.lat < 200 and p.lng < 200,st_distance_sphere(point(#{lng},#{lat}),p.pt)/10000,10000)
limit #{start},#{size}

select p.user_id userId, p.lat lat, p.lng lng, p.uptime `time`, d.nickname `nickname`, d.avatar avatar, d.role role, d.group `group`, d.con con, f.uptime followTime, l.im_id imId from corgi_user_follow f left join corgi_user_position p on f.user_id = p.user_id left join corgi_user_login l on l.id = p.user_id left join corgi_user_detail d on d.user_id = p.user_id where f.follow_user_id = #{userId} and is_deleted = '0' order by f.uptime desc limit #{start},#{size}

select d.nickname `nickname`, d.avatar avatar, d.avatar_status avatarStatus, d.role role, d.group `group`, d.con con, d.check_status checkStatus, p.user_id userId, p.lat lat, p.lng lng, p.uptime `time`, l.im_id imId, f.is_read isRead from corgi_user_follow f left join corgi_user_detail d on d.user_id = f.user_id left join corgi_user_position p on f.user_id = p.user_id left join corgi_user_login l on l.id = p.user_id where f.follow_user_id = #{userId} order by f.uptime desc limit #{start},#{size}
